name: Comb
flavor: A few teeth missing, but so is everyone's.

name: Nail
flavor: Bent, rusty, and somehow still pointy.

name: Dirty Cloth
flavor: You don't want to know what the stains are.

name: Hair
flavor: Whose is a question best left unasked.

name: Used Thong
flavor: It's seen things. It won't say what.

name: Droppings
flavor: Fresh-ish. That's the best you can say about it.

name: Charcoal
flavor: Still warm from something you'd rather not ask about.

name: Pan
flavor: Dented in a way that suggests a good story.

name: Razor
flavor: Dull, but still capable of ruining your day.

name: Oversized Hat
flavor: Falls over your eyes at the worst possible moment.

name: Rat Tooth
flavor: Sharper than it has any right to be.
